source.name: HIFLD Electric Power Transmission Lines via Esri Living Atlas (Federal User Community) 'U.S. Electric Power Transmission Lines (Archive)'

fields.name: hifld_id
fields.description: HIFLD transmission line unique identifier (source field ID, cast to int).

fields.name: owner
fields.description: Transmission line ownership entity (OWNER). 'NOT AVAILABLE'/'UNKNOWN' -> null.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Line type as given by HIFLD, e.g. AC/DC and overhead/underground (TYPE).

fields.name: voltage_kv
fields.description: Line voltage in kilovolts (VOLTAGE). -999999 and non-positive placeholders -> null.

fields.name: volt_class
fields.description: HIFLD voltage class bucket (VOLT_CLASS). 'NOT AVAILABLE' -> null.

fields.name: inferred
fields.description: Whether attributes (voltage) were inferred by HIFLD (INFERRED Y/N).

fields.name: naics_desc
enum: ELECTRIC BULK POWER TRANSMISSION AND CONTROL

fields.name: source
fields.description: Data source reference (SOURCE), often a URL or imagery citation.

fields.name: sourcedate
fields.description: Data source publication date (SOURCEDATE, UTC date of epoch ms).

fields.name: val_date
fields.description: Validation date (VAL_DATE, UTC date of epoch ms).

fields.name: shape_length_mi
fields.description: Geodesic length of the delivered geometry on the WGS84 ellipsoid (Vincenty), full line not clipped, 2 dp.

fields.name: distance_mi
fields.description: Haversine distance (R=3958.8 mi) from Westminster High School (33.7538,-118.0111) to the nearest vertex, 1 dp.

fields.name: vertex_count
fields.description: Number of vertices in the delivered geometry (all parts).
